It stubs the WeChat environment and statically checks app.json structure, per-page files, user-order compliance, engine-side (server repo) code, and tooling scripts — all offline, no devtools needed. Header docstring doubles as a version changelog of user orders (v0.5.0 用户令 / v0.5.1 教训级 / v0.7.0 用户十一点令 0930 ...).

Check pattern: `checks = []` module list + `def check(name, cond, detail=""): checks.append((name, bool(cond), detail))` + `def read(path): return open(os.path.join(ROOT, path), encoding="utf-8").read()`. Every file read passes encoding="utf-8" explicitly (never platform default — Windows GBK would mojibake CJK).

Final block is exactly: `fails = [c for c in checks if not c[1]]` then per-check print `("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name + (("  " + detail) if detail and not ok else "")` (detail printed only on FAIL), then summary `print(f"\nBOOT-SIM: {len(checks) - len(fails)}/{len(checks)} PASS")`, then `sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)`.

gotchas.symptom: Real-device button 点了没反应 (tap does nothing) while devtools looks fine — the free-consult CTA.
gotchas.root_cause: disabled attribute consumed the tap while custom styling visually overrode the greyed-out state, so users see an active-looking dead button.

gotchas.symptom: wx.showModal silently fails on real device (dialog never appears), historically worked around with a 'button text ≤4 chars' static gate.
gotchas.root_cause: Native modal constraints on real devices; the static length gate was a band-aid.
gotchas.fix: v0.9.7 replaced all native popups with the custom qw-pop component — the 4-char limit was uprooted and the defense upgraded to a project-wide scan asserting wx.showModal/showActionSheet/showLoading/wx.hideLoading calls are globally zero (comments stripped, whole project incl. utils/components/app.js).

gotchas.symptom: Payment receipt never delivered after vpay success (CRITICAL audit finding).

gotchas.symptom: Second purchase attempt fails with ORDER_CLOSED (-15012).
gotchas.root_cause: Reusing a previously-cancelled otn (待支付态 order) — WeChat rejects closed orders.
gotchas.fix: Engine opens a new pay order for stale unpaid ones (open_pay_order + cancel_pay_order, 作废重开 semantics); bootsim anchors '作废重开' in app.py.

gotchas.symptom: Loading overlay never dismisses (蒙层滞留) after openPdf or pop.loading.
gotchas.root_cause: hideLoading calls not paired 1:1 with loading calls across code paths.
gotchas.fix: Arithmetic gate: per page count(pop.hideLoading() >= count(pop.loading(); openPdf hides loading in success callback after openDocument (find-ordering assert); qw-pop detached() lifecycle clears _closeTimer so unmount-time setData cannot error.

gotchas.symptom: Concurrent popup corruption — a second popup fires while the first Promise still hangs.
gotchas.root_cause: Old pending Promise never settled when a new popup opens.
gotchas.fix: qw-pop settles the previous promise first: prev({ confirm: false, cancel: true, content: '' }) / prev(-1) before opening new — asserted verbatim in qw-pop.js.

gotchas.symptom: Negative assertion fails although display layer is clean.
gotchas.root_cause: Forbidden-word scans hit policy comments that legitimately explain the removal (e.g. comment naming the removed brand).
gotchas.fix: Strip comments before scanning (re.sub of // and /* */), keep the raw scan for positive anchors; policy text lives only in comments.

gotchas.symptom: Native-popup scan passed but forbidden calls remained in production.
gotchas.root_cause: Scan only covered pages/ — utils/pay.js, components/, app.js were blind spots.
gotchas.fix: os.walk the entire project root with dirnames filter (node_modules, miniprogram_npm, v095-audit excluded).

gotchas.symptom: e2e asserts stale code — checks pass but the just-written fix is not actually in the simulator.
gotchas.root_cause: devtools had not recompiled the new disk code when automator attached.
gotchas.fix: Step S0 version beacon: scrape my-page .muted elements for text containing 'v0.9.' and require it to equal the target version — beacon mismatch = recompile not picked up, fail early before other steps.

gotchas.symptom: e2e false-positives on 'popup appeared' when the payment loading legitimately shows.
gotchas.root_cause: Both confirmation modal and payment loading are popups; a single boolean cannot distinguish.
gotchas.fix: popMode discriminates: forbidden = popOpen && popMode==='modal'; allowed = popMode==='load' (支付链 loading，不是确认弹窗); fired-verdict accepts any of loading/sign-200/vpay_call.

gotchas.symptom: Payment chain hangs forever in e2e (loading spins indefinitely).
gotchas.root_cause: In devtools sandbox the native payment panel path never completes/cancels on its own.
gotchas.fix: Treat 'still loading after 4s' as a PASS detail tagged 'sandbox panel path', then reLaunch to leave the panel; never await sandbox payment completion.

gotchas.symptom: Test run accidentally triggers real WeCom push or real payment.
gotchas.root_cause: Side-effectful endpoints (invoice apply → 企微推送) and real vpay.
gotchas.fix: In-file discipline: no real invoice submission in e2e; payment stops at the vpay sandbox panel (cancel path). In pytest, _invoice_wecom_push monkeypatched silent by default, per-case capture or explode.

gotchas.symptom: Tests pass while real network calls leak (zhipu/secret present on machine).
gotchas.root_cause: Real zhipu.secret existing on the dev machine could make tests hit the network.
gotchas.fix: Fixture forces zhipu.configured → False and zhipu.rewrite → throw RuntimeError('测试默认禁用 zhipu'); metaso transports fully monkeypatched — 零真实调用.

gotchas.symptom: Tests interfere via shared module state (store singleton keeps prior DB).
gotchas.root_cause: store module caches _init_done and the sqlite handle at import time.
gotchas.fix: Set store._init_done = False before entering TestClient AND after yield (teardown), plus per-test DB_PATH/DATA_DIR into tmp_path.

gotchas.symptom: e2e screenshot failure kills the whole run.
gotchas.root_cause: mp.screenshot intermittently unavailable.
gotchas.fix: Every shot wrapped in try/catch with a '(shot skipped)' note — evidence collection is best-effort, verdicts come from data/trace assertions.

gotchas.symptom: Fixture hand-fed session_key made login-path tests lie (盲区#1).
gotchas.root_cause: Tests called store.save_session directly, bypassing the real login flow that persists session_key.
gotchas.fix: Login goes through the real /api/login leg with code2session monkeypatched — session_key proven to be persisted server-side by the production path; QW_DEV_LOGIN (no session_key) covered as its own 401 case.

gotchas.symptom: First frame flashes white on dark-mode devices; page-level dark CSS blocks reappear after refactors.
gotchas.root_cause: Theme applied only in onShow (after first paint) and per-page prefers-color-scheme duplicating theme-layer logic.
gotchas.fix: Double theme.apply(this) per page (onLoad+onShow, count>=2 asserted); dark rendering owned by theme layer — page wxss must contain zero prefers-color-scheme blocks (唯一例外 answer cite-pop ≤1).

gotchas.symptom: Category-chip highlight and list content disagree after a failed category switch on pot page.
gotchas.root_cause: activeCat was set optimistically before fetch; on failure list kept old content but chip moved.
gotchas.fix: Track _renderedCat and roll back `patch.activeCat = this._renderedCat` on failure.

gotchas.symptom: Exception during payment silently swallowed, chain appears frozen with no error surfaced.
gotchas.root_cause: Missing .catch on the payExportAll/payExport promise chains; empty catch in followup polling; cancel detection using wrong callback variable (r vs res) threw ReferenceError.
gotchas.fix: .catch((err) added after payExportAll()/payExport() (asserted by find-ordering); cancel branch reads String(res.message || '').indexOf('取消') < 0; followup polling has _fuFails backoff with 网络波动 error state instead of empty catch.

recipes.name: BOOT-SIM structural gate (demand-as-assertion)
recipes.steps: 1. Module-level `checks = []` + `def check(name, cond, detail="")` appending tuples; `def read(path)` joining ROOT with encoding="utf-8". 2. Assert app.json by exact list equality (pages, tabBar texts, entry page, custom, lazyCodeLoading). 3. Loop every page: json navigationStyle, js Page({ factory, nav binding, and every re.findall(r'bindtap="(\w+)"', wxml) handler must appear in js. 4. WXML tag-pair arithmetic per tag (view/block/scroll-view/template): opens == closes + selfclosed. 5. For each user order (banner comment with date), write checks whose names quote the order; swap anchors on semantic change (old string absent + new string present); never delete old checks — ratchet. 6. Pin UI inventory with exact counts (pill buttons, reward calls, ai-flag once per page, ap-cell count). 7. Positional layout via str.find() ordering chains. 8. Global forbidden-word os.walk scans collecting hits, assert empty, print hit list as detail; use comment-stripped copies for negative assertions. 9. Cross-repo engine assertions: read server files under ENGINE path, pin constants (EXPORT_PRICE_FEN=10) and endpoint decorators verbatim. 10. Assert test suites stay in service via sentinel test names. 11. Finish with the three-line verification: per-check PASS/FAIL print (detail only on FAIL) → `BOOT-SIM: X/Y PASS` summary → sys.exit(1 if fails else 0).

recipes.name: miniprogram-automator e2e (attach + hooks + data mirror)
recipes.steps: 1. `import automator from 'miniprogram-automator'`; mkdir SHOT_DIR recursive; define note()/sleep()/dataOf() helpers and errors ledger. 2. `const mp = await automator.connect({ wsEndpoint: 'ws://127.0.0.1:9420' })` (devtools automation port must already be open); `mp.on('exception', ...)` immediately. 3. Step 0 version beacon: reLaunch my page, sleep ~2200ms, scrape `.muted` texts for the version string — proves disk code reached devtools; bail mindset if mismatch. 4. Pre-seed state via `mp.callWxMethod('setStorageSync', 'qw_privacy_ok', 1)`. 5. Navigate with mp.reLaunch + sleep 2200-2400ms settle; read `await page.data()` for mirror assertions (popOpen/popMode), `page.$`/`page.$$` + el.text()/el.tap() for UI, sleep 1400ms after taps. 6. Install hooks in `mp.evaluate(() => {...})`: wrap wx.request (chain original complete, this-bound origReq.call(wx, opt)) and wx.requestVirtualPayment (record hasSignData, wrap fail) pushing into getApp().globalData._popTrace; read trace with a second evaluate. 7. Best-effort screenshots (try/catch, String.fromCharCode(92) separator, per-step filenames). 8. Assert no-new-exceptions per step via errBefore snapshot; final no_exceptions_total. 9. Write {results, errors} JSON artifact; print `E2E <tag>: X/Y PASS`; `await mp.disconnect(); process.exit(fails.length ? 1 : 0)`. Discipline: no side-effectful submissions; stop payment at sandbox panel (cancel path).

recipes.name: FastAPI engine pytest fixture (offline, isolated, tamper-proof)
recipes.steps: 1. `sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))`. 2. Fixture(tmp_path, monkeypatch): config.DB_PATH = tmp_path/'t.sqlite', config.DATA_DIR = tmp_path, store._init_done = False (again after yield). 3. Monkeypatch all external transports: wechat.code2session, wechat.msg_sec_check → True, metaso_kb.ask → fixed KbAnswer, _guard_enter/_record → no-op, zhipu.configured → False + zhipu.rewrite → throw, wechat.xpay_query_order → throw XpayError (sandbox-trust default, per-case override). 4. Virtual pay config via tmp secret file (offer_id/product ids/env=1/sandbox+prod appkeys) patched into config.VIRTUAL_PAY_FILE. 5. `with TestClient(app) as c: c.headers.update({'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + wechat.issue_token('open-t1')}); yield c`. 6. Drive the REAL login/ask/pay legs through HTTP — never hand-seed session data the production path is supposed to write. 7. Cover the adversarial matrix: forged otn/empty/cross-user → 404, NOTPAY → 400, prod query outage → 503 fail-closed, idempotent replays, snapshot semantics, entropy collisions. Run: `python -m pytest tests/<file> -q`.

recipes.name: Virtual-pay dual-signature verification with official vectors
recipes.steps: 1. Keep a plain-script module (module-level asserts, `python tests/test_pay_sign.py`) so it runs anywhere without pytest. 2. Test 0: pin the official doc vectors end-to-end — known body/uri/keys must produce the exact documented pay_sig and signature hex strings. 3. Test 1: signData must serialize compact (separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) — byte-identical to what the client transparently passes. 4. Test 2: recompute both HMACs independently per current spec: paySig = HMAC(appKey, 'requestVirtualPayment&' + body), signature = HMAC(session_key, body) 无前缀, both 64-hex. 5. Test 3: key isolation — changing session_key alters only signature; changing appKey alters only pay_sig.

recipes.name: In-service test anchor (meta-regression)
recipes.steps: To stop test files from being silently deleted or renamed: bootsim asserts os.path.exists(test file) AND that a distinctive sentinel test name is still present in its source, e.g. 'test_prod_query_outage_fail_closed' in test_export_pay.py (21 用例), 'test_unlock_paid_forged_and_cross_user' in test_report_mall.py, 'test_apply_push_failure_fail_open' in test_invoice.py. Renaming/removing the sentinel turns the structural gate red.

recipes.name: Theme governance check for component wxss
recipes.steps: 1. Strip block comments: re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', wxss, flags=re.S). 2. Assert zero hex colors: re.findall(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}', stripped) must be empty. 3. Collect used tokens set(re.findall(r'--t-[a-z0-9-]+', wxss)) and assert every one is defined in utils/theme.js — typos in variable names turn red.

recipes.name: Ground-truth telemetry for the devtools-green/device-dead blind zone
recipes.steps: 1. utils/telemetry.js exports fire-and-forget ping() that never throws, with anonymous boot id, posting to /api/telemetry. 2. Wire events at each funnel step: tel.boot() in app.js; ask_tap/ask_ok/ask_fail/ask_quota; export_tap; xall_tap; buy_tap. 3. Server: POST /api/telemetry public, GET /api/telemetry/recent gated by x-tel-key header (hmac.compare_digest) with secret from TELEMETRY_SECRET_FILE; persistence via store.save_telemetry. 4. bootsim pins all wiring strings so the leg cannot be silently unplugged.

recipes.name: E2E result artifact for later audit
recipes.steps: fs.writeFileSync(RESULT_PATH, JSON.stringify({ results, errors }, null, 2)) where results = [{name, ok, detail}] from note() calls and errors = the mp exception ledger. Keep result JSON next to a shots directory; each detail carries the observed values (beacon text, popOpen/popMode, trace excerpt) so a failure is diagnosable without re-running.
